rooms.name: General Ward 01
rooms.notes: 6-bed general ward; NBC IPHS minimum 7.5 sqm per bed; 6 beds @ ~5.3 sqm net = 32 sqm. Natural light and ventilation on external facade preferred.

rooms.name: General Ward 02
rooms.notes: 6-bed general ward; same standard as Ward 01. External facade preferred for natural ventilation.

rooms.name: General Ward 03
rooms.notes: 6-bed general ward; same standard as Ward 01. External facade preferred.

rooms.name: General Ward 04
rooms.notes: 6-bed general ward; brings total ward beds on this floor to 24. External facade preferred.

rooms.name: Semi-Private Ward 05
rooms.notes: 2-bed semi-private ward; 9 sqm per bed per IPHS. External window mandatory.

rooms.name: Semi-Private Ward 06
rooms.notes: 2-bed semi-private ward; mirrors Ward 05 on opposite side of corridor.

rooms.name: Nurses' Station
rooms.notes: Central nurses' station with clear sightlines down ward corridor. Includes duty desk, medication trolley bay and charting area. NBC Group C compliance.

rooms.name: Ward Corridor
rooms.notes: Main ward corridor; minimum 2.4 m clear width per NBC for hospital wards to allow stretcher/wheelchair movement. Total 72 sqm for a ~30 m run.

rooms.name: Patient Toilet & Bathroom Block 01
rooms.notes: Accessible patient bathrooms serving Wards 01-03; minimum 2 WC + 2 shower units per NBC IPHS. Wet area waterproofing mandatory.

rooms.name: Patient Toilet & Bathroom Block 02
rooms.notes: Accessible patient bathrooms serving Wards 04-06; minimum 2 WC + 2 shower units per NBC IPHS. Wet area waterproofing mandatory.

rooms.name: Ward Store / Linen Room
rooms.notes: Linen, consumables and equipment storage for ward floor. Adjacent to nurses' station for controlled access.

rooms.name: Ward Pantry
rooms.notes: Patient meal plating, hot-case storage and utensil washing area. Complies with hospital kitchen hygiene separation requirements.

response.floor_summary: Floor 1 is the general ward floor of the multi-speciality hospital, housing six inpatient wards (totalling approximately 50 beds), a central nurses' station, two accessible patient bathroom blocks, a ward corridor of stretcher-compliant width, a ward store/linen room, and a ward pantry — all designed to NBC Group C (Institutional) and IPHS standards.
